run_confirm_close: The measurement is running. Stop it and close the window?
run_q_calibration_details: Sweep: {start} to {stop}, {points} points. Calibrate the VNA over this range first.
run_q_load_details:
{load}: {description}
Connect the resistors as drawn, between the output of the converter (+) and ground (−). The supply is off.
run_q_zero_short: Channel {channel} {name}: step 1 of 2. Connect its two input terminals together, so that the instrument measures only the offset of the wiring and of its input, and then continue.
run_q_zero_back: Channel {channel} {name}: step 2 of 2. The offset was taken {offset}. Connect the terminals back where they were and continue.
run_waves_align_help: Shift the oscilloscopes with the signal they share, as computed by Align now.
run_waves_hint: Wheel: zoom time (Ctrl: voltage). Drag: move. Click: cursors A and B. Double click: reset.
run_waves_align_need: Needs two oscilloscopes in the run, with a channel of the same name on both.
run_q_calibration_question: Is the VNA calibrated for this device and this frequency range?
run_q_reverse_device: Turn the device round: its input on port 2 and its output on port 1 of the VNA, with the same cables. Then continue to read {parameters}.
run_q_forward_device: Put the device back the right way round: its input on port 1, its output on port 2.
run_connect_attenuator: Connect the attenuator under test between port 1 and port 2 of the VNA.
run_connect_filter: Connect the filter under test between port 1 and port 2 of the VNA.
run_connect_cable: Connect the cable under test between port 1 and port 2 of the VNA.
run_connect_cable_reflection: Connect one end of the cable under test to port 1 and put an {far} circuit on the other end.
run_connect_antenna: Connect the antenna to port 1 of the VNA.
run_connect_device: Connect the device under test to port 1 of the VNA.
run_connect_sparameters: Connect the device under test to the VNA (it reads {parameters}).
run_connect_behind_cable_antenna: The antenna is behind the cable that was measured: connect that cable to port 1 of the VNA (calibrated at the end of the test lead, WITHOUT the cable) and the antenna to its other end.
run_connect_behind_cable_device: The device is behind the cable that was measured: connect that cable to port 1 of the VNA (calibrated at the end of the test lead, WITHOUT the cable) and the device under test to its other end.
run_connect_line: Connect the line under test to port 1 of the VNA, with its far end open, shorted or on the device.
run_connect_amplifier: Connect the amplifier between port 1 and port 2 of the VNA, with the attenuators that were part of the calibration. Check that the amplifier output cannot exceed the maximum input power of the VNA and that the source power cannot damage the amplifier input.
run_connect_amplifier_max: Connect the amplifier between port 1 and port 2 of the VNA, with the attenuators that were part of the calibration. Check that the amplifier output cannot exceed the maximum input power of the VNA and that no more than {max} dBm reaches the amplifier input.
run_q_plan_head: The loads, planned again from the voltage the converter gave:
run_q_plan_row: {target} A: {combination} = {ohm} Ω, {current} A at {volts} V, {changes} to move
run_q_load_open: Disconnect everything from the output of the converter ('{parameter}': '{load}', {formula}). The converter is switched off. Then continue.
run_q_load_connect: Connect the load '{load}' of '{parameter}': {formula}, to the output of the converter. The converter is switched off. Then continue.
run_q_outputs_on_end: These outputs are already on and will be switched off when the measurement ends: {names}. Continue, or stop to change the file?
run_q_verify_pct: '{variable}' read by {reading} ({read}) differs from the set value ({set}) by {pct} %; allowed: {tol_abs} + {tol_rel} %
run_q_verify_zero: '{variable}' read by {reading} ({read}) differs from the set value (0) by {error}; allowed: {tol_abs} + {tol_rel} %
run_q_bode_nosw: Connect the generator to the input of the circuit and to the oscilloscope channel {input}, and the output of the circuit to channel {output}. WARNING: this generator has no command to switch its output on and off, so it is on as soon as the amplitude is set ({amp} Vpp) and stays on at the end: switch it off by hand. Continue, or abort (nothing is set).
run_q_bode_setup: Connect the generator to the input of the circuit and to the oscilloscope channel {input}, and the output of the circuit to channel {output}. The generator is switched on by the measurement ({amp} Vpp) and switched off at the end. Then continue.
run_q_reg_setup: Connect the supply to the input of the converter, the voltmeter (or the datalogger channel) to its output. The supply is switched on by the measurement and switched off at the end. Then continue.
run_q_reg_setup_load: Connect the supply to the input of the converter, the voltmeter (or the datalogger channel) to its output, and the electronic load to the output. The supply and the load are switched on by the measurement, the load at 0 A first, and switched off at the end. Then continue.
run_q_ripple_setup: Connect the probe across the output of the supply, as close to the output capacitor as possible, with the ground spring (no long ground lead: it picks up the switching spikes) and the 20 MHz limit on. The supply must be on and stable. Then continue.
run_q_ripple_setup_load: Connect the probe across the output of the supply, as close to the output capacitor as possible, with the ground spring (no long ground lead: it picks up the switching spikes) and the 20 MHz limit on. The load is switched on by the measurement. The supply must be on and stable. Then continue.
run_q_zero_main_back: Zero of channel {label} done: step 2 of 2.
run_q_zero_main_back_offset: Zero of channel {label} done (offset {offset}): step 2 of 2.
run_view_smith_unavailable: The Smith chart needs complex data (S-parameters): some of the shown curves are not.
run_file_not_kept: The measurement failed and was not saved (Settings: keep the measurements that failed).
